question.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

exchange.sent: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not rank the “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they explicitly point to these capability areas: high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow covering IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and TL calculation; transmission-channel/interface validation with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk/PLL jitter and phase-noise validation; PDN / power-integrity validation; ADC/DAC frontend performance validation; and, for wireless infrastructure, MIMO/beamforming, OTA, higher-frequency / wider-bandwidth testing, and digital design & power capabilities [1][3][19][22][24].
| Capability area | What to cover | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator are listed as the signal integrity flow items for high-speed PCB/PCBA [1][3][19]. | [1][3][19] |
| PCB material / stackup / process SI | PCB test solutions list material measurement with impedance TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram; SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness and impedance; plus sampling testing and process monitoring [16][77]. | [16][77] |
| Transmission-channel and interface validation | High-speed electrical-interface validation is broken into transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, interface test, RefClk and PLL jitter performance, PDN, and ADC/DAC frontend performance [3][19]. | [3][19] |
| Interface test instrumentation | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| RefClk / PLL jitter and phase-noise performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance is mapped to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Power integrity / PDN validation | Power Distribution Network validation is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Wireless-infrastructure drivers | Wireless network infrastructure drivers include increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands / higher frequencies / expanding bandwidth, and digital design & power [22]. | [22] |
| Wireless-infrastructure solution mapping | For digital design & power, the solution mapping lists VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes and signal source [24]. | [24] |
| Beamforming-related SI / RF coherence capability | Beamforming measurement tasks include calibrating antenna element RF ports, measuring amplitude and phase / time relation between ports, and calculating beam direction / beam weights [44]. | [44] |
| Wireless certification context | Wireless communication certification labs cover RF, EMC, safety and conformance certification, with test items including spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, and PTCRB/GCF certification [4]. | [4] |
### 推論
【推論】For Wireless Communication applications, the SI capability set should combine high-speed PCB/PCBA channel integrity, clock/jitter integrity, PDN integrity, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and wireless-specific MIMO/beamforming/OTA/higher-frequency requirements, because these are the SI/PI validation blocks and wireless infrastructure drivers explicitly listed in the passages [3][19][22][24][44].

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

R&S FSWP50 › Phase noise measurements
- Measurement results：SSB phase noise、spurious signals、integrated RMS phase deviation、residual FM、time jitter。
- Offset frequency range：
  - carrier frequency ≤ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to max. input frequency − carrier frequency。
  - carrier frequency ≥ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to 1 GHz。
- Signal level range：
  - level setting = high：−20 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low：−40 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low 且 I/Q lowpass ≤ 10 MHz：−50 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
- Number of traces：6。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty 條件：DUT phase noise ≥ 10 dB above phase noise sensitivity of R&S®FSWP。
  - 1 µHz ≤ offset < 10 mHz：1.5 dB nominal。
  - 10 mHz ≤ offset < 1 MHz：< 1.2 dB，σ = 0.4 dB。
  - 1 MHz ≤ offset ≤ 30 MHz：< 1.5 dB，σ = 0.5 dB。
  - 30 MHz < offset：< 3 dB，σ = 1.0 dB。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty specified values 適用於 offset frequencies ≤ 30 % of signal frequency。
- DUT phase noise 若高於 R&S®FSWP phase noise sensitivity 6 dB 至 10 dB，uncertainty 增加 1 dB。
- Phase noise level measurement uncertainty，條件為 −20 dBm ≤ signal level ≤ 15 dBm，+20 °C to +30 °C：
  - 1 MHz ≤ signal frequency < 8 GHz：< 1 dB。
  - 8 GHz ≤ signal frequency < 18 GHz：< 2 dB。
  - 18 GHz ≤ signal frequency：< 3 dB。

R&S FSWP50 › RF input 與頻率範圍
- Phase noise / AM noise measurements：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
- With R&S®FSWP-B56G option：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 56 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 56 GHz。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Baseband noise measurement frequency range：
  - RF input, AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - RF input, DC coupled：10 mHz to 50 GHz。
  - With R&S®FSWP-B56G，RF input AC coupled：10 MHz to 56 GHz。
  - With R&S®FSWP-B56G，RF input DC coupled：10 mHz to 56 GHz。
  - Baseband input：AC coupled 0.3 Hz to 40 MHz 或 100 Hz to 40 MHz；DC coupled 10 mHz to 40 MHz。
- Transient analysis frequency range：
  - DC coupled：1 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - AC coupled：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
- Allan deviation / Allan variance frequency range：1 MHz to 50 GHz。

R&S SMW200A › Unresolved

- RF path combination table 的全部 allowed / not allowed combinations 與灰底 deeper chassis 條件需回查原表；本頁只照錄來源明列摘要與 `R&S®SMW-B94L` 明列條件。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。

- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。

- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。

  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。

- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

R&S FSWP50 › 基本定位
- 產品名稱：R&S®FSWP Phase Noise Analyzer and VCO Tester。
- 型號：R&S®FSWP50。
- 主要功能：[[Phase noise measurement]]、[[AM noise measurement]]、[[Baseband noise measurement]]、[[VCO characterization]]、[[Transient analysis]]、[[Allan deviation]] / [[Allan variance]]。

R&S FSWP50 › VCO characterization
- Sweep parameters：DC tune voltage V tune、DC auxiliary voltage V aux、DC supply voltage V supply、DC supply current I supply。
- Measurement parameters：frequency、RF power、DC supply current、tuning sensitivity。
- Frequency resolution：100 mHz to 100 kHz，steps of 1, 10, …。
- RF power measurement range：
  - 1 MHz ≤ signal frequency ≤ 100 MHz：–15 dBm to +27 dBm。
  - signal frequency > 100 MHz：–20 dBm to +27 dBm。
- VCO level measurement uncertainty，條件為 –20 dBm ≤ signal level ≤ 15 dBm，+20 °C to +30 °C：
  - 1 MHz ≤ signal frequency < 8 GHz：< 1 dB。
  - 8 GHz ≤ signal frequency < 18 GHz：< 2 dB。
  - signal frequency ≥ 18 GHz：< 3 dB。

R&S FSWP50 › 軟體 licence
- 主要 firmware licence 列於 [[R&S FSWP]]；本型號適用性需依 requires（例如 R&S®FSWP-B1、R&S®FSWP-B64）確認。

R&S FSWP50 › Transient analysis
- Measurement parameters：narrow mode / wide mode 為 frequency；narrow mode additionally 為 phase。
- Frequency transient bandwidth：narrow mode 40 MHz；wide mode 256 MHz to 8 GHz。
- RF input level range：
  - narrow mode：−20 dBm to +20 dBm。
  - wide mode 256 MHz to 6 GHz：−15 dBm to +20 dBm。
  - wide mode 6 GHz to 7 GHz：−10 dBm to +20 dBm。
  - wide mode 7 GHz to 8 GHz：0 dBm to +20 dBm。
- Time span：1 µs to 16 s；time resolution：> 20 ns。
- Measurement trigger：free run、external、frequency；external trigger polarity positive / negative，3.3 V TTL level；pretrigger delay `(–1) × time span` to 16 s。
- Phase uncertainty：DUT signal locked to target frequency 時為 `0.05° + 0.1°/GHz`。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank the “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they explicitly point to these capability areas: high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow covering IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and TL calculation; transmission-channel/interface validation with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk/PLL jitter and phase-noise validation; PDN / power-integrity validation; ADC/DAC frontend performance validation; and, for wireless infrastructure, MIMO/beamforming, OTA, higher-frequency / wider-bandwidth testing, and digital design & power capabilities [1][3][19][22][24].
| Capability area | What to cover | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator are listed as the signal integrity flow items for high-speed PCB/PCBA [1][3][19]. | [1][3][19] |
| PCB material / stackup / process SI | PCB test solutions list material measurement with impedance TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram; SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness and impedance; plus sampling testing and process monitoring [16][77]. | [16][77] |
| Transmission-channel and interface validation | High-speed electrical-interface validation is broken into transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, interface test, RefClk and PLL jitter performance, PDN, and ADC/DAC frontend performance [3][19]. | [3][19] |
| Interface test instrumentation | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| RefClk / PLL jitter and phase-noise performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance is mapped to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Power integrity / PDN validation | Power Distribution Network validation is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Wireless-infrastructure drivers | Wireless network infrastructure drivers include increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands / higher frequencies / expanding bandwidth, and digital design & power [22]. | [22] |
| Wireless-infrastructure solution mapping | For digital design & power, the solution mapping lists VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes and signal source [24]. | [24] |
| Beamforming-related SI / RF coherence capability | Beamforming measurement tasks include calibrating antenna element RF ports, measuring amplitude and phase / time relation between ports, and calculating beam direction / beam weights [44]. | [44] |
| Wireless certification context | Wireless communication certification labs cover RF, EMC, safety and conformance certification, with test items including spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, and PTCRB/GCF certification [4]. | [4] |
### 推論
【推論】For Wireless Communication applications, the SI capability set should combine high-speed PCB/PCBA channel integrity, clock/jitter integrity, PDN integrity, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and wireless-specific MIMO/beamforming/OTA/higher-frequency requirements, because these are the SI/PI validation blocks and wireless infrastructure drivers explicitly listed in the passages [3][19][22][24][44].

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。

- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。

- Network energy saving：[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07、RT-ZC31、[[R&S SMW-K546]]、[[R&S FSW-K18]]。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。

- Offset frequency range：
  - carrier frequency ≤ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to max. input frequency − carrier frequency。
  - carrier frequency ≥ maximum input frequency − 1 GHz：1 µHz to 1 GHz。
- Signal level range：
  - level setting = high：−20 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low：−40 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
  - level setting = low 且 I/Q lowpass ≤ 10 MHz：−50 dBm to +30 dBm nominal。
- Number of traces：6。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty 條件：DUT phase noise ≥ 10 dB above phase noise sensitivity of R&S®FSWP。
  - 1 µHz ≤ offset < 10 mHz：1.5 dB nominal。
  - 10 mHz ≤ offset < 1 MHz：< 1.2 dB，σ = 0.4 dB。
  - 1 MHz ≤ offset ≤ 30 MHz：< 1.5 dB，σ = 0.5 dB。
  - 30 MHz < offset：< 3 dB，σ = 1.0 dB。
- Phase noise measurement uncertainty specified values 適用於 offset frequencies ≤ 30 % of signal frequency。
- DUT phase noise 若高於 R&S®FSWP phase noise sensitivity 6 dB 至 10 dB，uncertainty 增加 1 dB。
- Phase noise level measurement uncertainty，條件為 −20 dBm ≤ signal level ≤ 15 dBm，+20 °C to +30 °C：
  - 1 MHz ≤ signal frequency < 8 GHz：< 1 dB。
  - 8 GHz ≤ signal frequency < 18 GHz：< 2 dB。
  - 18 GHz ≤ signal frequency：< 3 dB。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › 測量任務
依 Slide 41–42：

- 測試設備 must provide at least 2 connectors to DUT。
- Sequential measurement is allowed。
- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。
- TER must extract or calculate weights, magnitude / phase relation or beam direction。
- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：
  - Calibrate antenna element RF ports for valid beamforming capabilities。
  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。
- O-RAN Conformance Test Specification chapter 3.2.3.2ff 涉及 analog beamforming（TD）and/or digital beamforming（FD）。
- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。

O-RAN Beamforming Measurements › UL concept
依 Slide 44：

- General Concept – BFM Measurement UL 使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 `2* SISO (orthogonal DMRS)` signal。

- [[R&S VSE]] software measures delta phase and/or EVM。
- 來源還標示 PCAP Capture。
- Phase measurement is based on DMRS（Pilots）which are orthogonal。

### Short answer
The passages do not rank the “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication, but they explicitly point to these capability areas: high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow covering IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning and TL calculation; transmission-channel/interface validation with scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; RefClk/PLL jitter and phase-noise validation; PDN / power-integrity validation; ADC/DAC frontend performance validation; and, for wireless infrastructure, MIMO/beamforming, OTA, higher-frequency / wider-bandwidth testing, and digital design & power capabilities [1][3][19][22][24].
| Capability area | What to cover | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| High-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow | IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator are listed as the signal integrity flow items for high-speed PCB/PCBA [1][3][19]. | [1][3][19] |
| PCB material / stackup / process SI | PCB test solutions list material measurement with impedance TDR and DK/DF extraction; stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram; SI modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness and impedance; plus sampling testing and process monitoring [16][77]. | [16][77] |
| Transmission-channel and interface validation | High-speed electrical-interface validation is broken into transmission channel, measurement path to DUT / test board development, interface test, RefClk and PLL jitter performance, PDN, and ADC/DAC frontend performance [3][19]. | [3][19] |
| Interface test instrumentation | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| RefClk / PLL jitter and phase-noise performance | RefClk and PLL jitter performance is mapped to phase noise analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Power integrity / PDN validation | Power Distribution Network validation is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| ADC / DAC frontend performance | ADC / DAC frontend performance is mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Wireless-infrastructure drivers | Wireless network infrastructure drivers include increasing MIMO degrees and beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands / higher frequencies / expanding bandwidth, and digital design & power [22]. | [22] |
| Wireless-infrastructure solution mapping | For digital design & power, the solution mapping lists VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes and signal source [24]. | [24] |
| Beamforming-related SI / RF coherence capability | Beamforming measurement tasks include calibrating antenna element RF ports, measuring amplitude and phase / time relation between ports, and calculating beam direction / beam weights [44]. | [44] |
| Wireless certification context | Wireless communication certification labs cover RF, EMC, safety and conformance certification, with test items including spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, EMI/EMS, ESD, power surge, protocol compatibility, interoperability, and PTCRB/GCF certification [4]. | [4] |
### 推論
【推論】For Wireless Communication applications, the SI capability set should combine high-speed PCB/PCBA channel integrity, clock/jitter integrity, PDN integrity, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and wireless-specific MIMO/beamforming/OTA/higher-frequency requirements, because these are the SI/PI validation blocks and wireless infrastructure drivers explicitly listed in the passages [3][19][22][24][44].

依 Slide 41–42：

- Test frame is repeated with identical settings until TER synch, demod & extract beam weights。

- For UL measurements, repeat and apply different beam weights。
- Best performance（EVM, power, SNR）is expected only with the correct beam weights。
- Measurement task 包含：

  - Measure amplitude and phase / time relation between ports。
  - Calculate resulting beam direction / beam weights。

- One beam per section at a time。
- At least two antenna ports must be measured。
- Simultaneous and sequential testing are possible。
